translationRepairs: Wei Chawei of the Ministry of Personnel, on reading his examination answers, declared that no one under heaven could match him.
Qian Weidao of the Ministry of Personnel, on reading his examination answers, declared that no one under heaven could match him.
Chinese 騫味道 is Qian Weidao (騫 Qiān + 味道 Wèidào); Wei Chawei misreads the surname and given name. The proposed idiomatic corrects only that personal name.
Wei Chawei, Vice Director of the Ministry of Personnel, seeing his examination answers, declared him unmatched under heaven.
Qian Weidao, Vice Director of the Ministry of Personnel, seeing his examination answers, declared him unmatched under heaven.
The literal likewise has Wei Chawei for 騫味道; Qian Weidao is the correct reading, and the rest of the proposed literal matches the Chinese.
